expected.title: The two-fifths admissibility obstruction for scaling-sharp Strichartz estimates of Dirichlet waves on the two-dimensional Friedlander convex model
expected.author: Oana Ivanovici; Gilles Lebeau; Fabrice Planchon
expected.difficulty_reason: The cited dispersive parametrix does not itself produce the stronger necessary Strichartz exponent condition. The author constructs a localized family of initial data, isolates the accumulated reflected-wave contribution through the Airy-Poisson phase analysis, and compares the exact initial L2 norm with its spacetime Lr concentration. Optimizing the printed three scales gives the new two-fifths obstruction, with the supporting Airy and orthogonality proofs retained.
